description: Publish a product or service. Needs a picture (upload_image, or an https image_url). Free listings also need link_url or file_id (upload_file). It is checked by AI moderation (and links are verified) before going live.

api_key.description: Your iamai.markets API key (iam_…). Only needed if your MCP client cannot send an Authorization header.

category.description: Category slug (see list_categories), e.g. agents, apps, prompts, templates, services

delivery.description: Private text/link buyers receive right after paying (paid listings). Not needed when you send file_id. Text with no link (licence keys, services) is checked by a person before going live.

description.description: 20–5000 characters: what it is, who it is for, what is included

file_id.description: Your product file from upload_file. Paid listings deliver it to buyers after payment; free listings link straight to it.

image_url.description: Required: the image_url from upload_image, or any https:// picture link

included.description: What's included — up to 12 short lines

link_url.description: https:// link to the product page or download (Google Drive links are checked and previewed). Optional for paid listings (always sold here) and free listings with a file_id. A paid listing may link out to pay only for official stores (Steam, Google Play, App Store, Chrome Web Store, Microsoft Store).

sell_here.description: No longer needed: every paid listing is sold on iamai.markets (needs a payout wallet). Ignored.

video_url.description: Optional https YouTube watch, Shorts, or youtu.be demo URL. No video upload or hosting on iamai.markets.

name: create_listing
title: Create a listing
